findings.detail: AgentActivity.sendCurrentInput computes routeExplicit ?: routeFromSession and both Proven and Withheld emit a reply and return unconditionally before public web routing and runContinuumDialogue/model. preserveLocalContext retains immutable evidence; proof questions are not appended as new source assertions.

Answer.support uses the exact Found returned only after probe, independent verifier and ordered-role adapter agreement. It retains sourceId/revision/source hash/start/end; snapshot hash remains separate.

Unscoped correction/pronominal-location patterns checked before subject filter. Direct helper rejects any oversized/control-bearing source in the4-turn window. Atomic sessionEvidence returns null for omitted oversized owner literal; routing treats null as terminal incomplete evidence. Named oversized confirmed fact also blocks helper.

Only original request literal reaches owner context; model response and research digest question excluded from proof. No new persistence, cookies, permissions, model promotion, network call or owner fact mutation.

routeExplicit recognition still requires complete bounded grammar: single-line Beleg<=2000, Frage<=160 and supported bare named location question. Malformed/multiline/oversized explicit evidence returns null and continues old routing. Do not describe this as universal explicit-evidence fail-closed behavior. A future narrow regression should pin intended oversized/malformed behavior if broadening that guarantee.

sendCurrentInput already trims EditText text before routing; proof offsets bind accepted request/source strings, not raw UI buffer byte positions. Explicit answer also scopes offsets to extracted trimmed evidence. Session tests correctly prove exact offsets within the literal given to Context.
Confirmed-fact no-in/unsupported invalidators remain separate pre-existing R3 scope. No general semantic, temporal or model accuracy claim follows from fixed regex cases.
